common.name: Premium Bedroll
common.description: During downtime, you automatically clear a Stress.

common.name: Piper Whistle
common.description: This handcrafted whistle has a distinctive sound. When you blow this whistle, its piercing tone can be heard within a 1-mile radius.

common.name: Charging Quiver
common.description: When you succeed on an attack with an arrow stored in this quiver, gain a bonus to the damage roll equal to your current tier.

common.name: Alistair's Torch
common.description: You can light this magic torch at will. The flame's light fills a much larger space than it should, enough to illuminate a cave bright as day.

common.name: Speaking Orbs
common.description: This pair of orbs allows any creatures holding them to communicate with each other across any distance.

common.name: Manacles
common.description: This pair of locking cuffs comes with a key.

common.name: Arcane Cloak
common.description: A creature with a Spellcast trait wearing this cloak can adjust its color, texture, and size at will.

common.name: Woven Net
common.description: You can make a Finesse Roll using this net to trap a small creature. A trapped target can break free with a successful Attack Roll (16).

common.name: Fire Jar
common.description: You can pour out the strange liquid contents of this jar to instantly produce fire. The contents regenerate when you take a long rest.

common.name: Suspended Rod
common.description: This flat rod is inscribed with runes. When you activate the rod, it is immediately suspended in place. Until deactivated, it can't move and doesn't abide by gravity.

common.name: Glamour Stone
common.description: Activate this pebble-sized stone to memorize the appearance of someone you can see. Spend a Hope to magically recreate this guise on yourself as an illusion.

common.name: Empty Chest
common.description: This magical chest appears empty. When you speak a specific trigger word or action and open the chest, you can see the items stored within it.

uncommon.name: Companion Case
uncommon.description: This case can fit a small animal companion. While the companion is inside, the animal and case are immune to all damage and harmful effects.

uncommon.name: Piercing Arrows
uncommon.description: Three times per rest when you succeed on an attack with one of these arrows, you can add your Proficiency to the damage roll.

uncommon.name: Valorstone
uncommon.description: You can attach this stone to armor that doesn't already have a feature. The armor gains Resilient: Before you mark your last Armor Slot, roll a d6. On a 6, reduce severity by one threshold.

uncommon.name: Skeleton Key
uncommon.description: When you use this key to open a locked door, you gain advantage on the Finesse Roll.

uncommon.name: Arcane Prism
uncommon.description: Position this prism and activate it. All allies within Close range gain +1 to Spellcast Rolls. Can't be moved while active. Recharges on long rest.

uncommon.name: Minor Stamina Potion Recipe
uncommon.description: As a downtime move, you can use the bone of a creature to craft a Minor Stamina Potion.

uncommon.name: Minor Health Potion Recipe
uncommon.description: As a downtime move, you can use a vial of blood to craft a Minor Health Potion.

uncommon.name: Homing Compasses
uncommon.description: These two compasses point toward each other no matter how far apart they are.

uncommon.name: Corrector Sprite
uncommon.description: This tiny sprite sits in your ear canal and whispers helpful advice during combat. Once per short rest, gain advantage on an attack roll.

uncommon.name: Gecko Gloves
uncommon.description: You can climb up vertical surfaces and across ceilings.

uncommon.name: Lorekeeper
uncommon.description: You can store the name and details of up to three hostile creatures inside this book. You gain +1 to action rolls against those creatures.

uncommon.name: Vial of Darksmoke Recipe
uncommon.description: As a downtime move, you can mark a Stress to craft a Vial of Darksmoke.

rare.name: Bloodstone
rare.description: Attach to a weapon without a feature. Brutal: When you roll the maximum value on a damage die, roll an additional damage die.

rare.name: Greatstone
rare.description: Attach to a weapon without a feature. Powerful: On a successful attack, roll an additional damage die and discard the lowest result.

rare.name: Glider
rare.description: While falling, you can mark a Stress to deploy this small parachute and glide safely to the ground.

rare.name: Ring of Silence
rare.description: Spend a Hope to activate this ring. Your footsteps are silent until your next rest.

rare.name: Calming Pendant
rare.description: When you would mark your last Stress, roll a d6. On a result of 5 or higher, don't mark it.

rare.name: Dual Flask
rare.description: This flask can hold two different liquids. You can swap between them by flipping a small switch on the flask's side.

rare.name: Bag of Ficklesand
rare.description: You can convince this small bag of sand to be much heavier or lighter with a successful Presence Roll (10). Also can blow sand in target's face to make them Vulnerable.

rare.name: Ring of Resistance
rare.description: Once per long rest, you can activate this ring after a successful attack against you to halve the damage.

rare.name: Phoenix Feather
rare.description: If you have at least one Phoenix Feather when you fall unconscious, you gain +1 to the roll to determine whether you gain a scar.

rare.name: Box of Many Goods
rare.description: Once per long rest, roll a d12. On 1-6 it's empty. On 7-10, contains one random common consumable. On 11-12, contains two.

rare.name: Airblade Charm
rare.description: Attach to a weapon with Melee range. Three times per rest, you can activate the charm and attack a target within Close range.

rare.name: Portal Seed
